# Camrett Logistics

Camrett Logistics is a Warehousing and Storage company. Camrett Logistics provides 3PL services and warehousing/distribution since 1995. They are located along the I-81 corridor in southwest Virginia. Camrett Logistics employs 83 people (+12.2% YoY, +9 people) and has an annual revenue of $27.2M, founded in 1995. Headquartered in Wytheville, Virginia, United States, with offices including Rural Retreat, Atkins, Pulaski, Roanoke, and Beaver.

## About

Camrett Logistics has been providing 3PL services: warehousing & distribution services since 1995. 
Camrett is a SmartWay Transport Provider and has several warehouses that are AIB certified for Food Safety.
We employ highly-trained personnel and smart technology to offer value-added services thereby optimizing your supply chain management and cost.
